static_traits.name: Liu Fan
static_traits.family_status: Living alone, living with a cat named Jasper; Not mentioned other family members
static_traits.social_status: Has several colleagues to talk to, but has not yet shared Guilt and self-blame feelings with them
static_traits.medical_history: No similar psychological problems or psychotherapy experience in the past; without significant physical illness
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, well organized; able to self-reflect and cognitively reframe; high cooperation, Positive attitude

basic_info.main_problem: Because the cat Jasper developed an ear infection, producing strong guilt and self-blame, believing I am a terrible pet owner; this self-blame appears daily, especially when administering medication or cleaning the ears, and affects sleep and work focus.
basic_info.core_demands: 'I hope to have a greater sense of control and reduce guilt, so that I can focus more at work and obtain better sleep.' In addition, 'I decided to seek counseling when these feelings of guilt affected my daily functioning and overall well-being.'

core_beliefs: I am a terrible pet owner
Anything that goes wrong is my fault

special_situations.event: Last week, when taking Jasper to see the doctor, he was diagnosed with an ear infection and prescribed a follow-up treatment plan
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If my pet gets sick, it means I do not care for it well, I am a failure as an owner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Seeks medical care quickly and strictly follows the treatment plan, investing more time in care to 'make up for' the fault
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is my fault; I am a terrible pet owner

special_situations.event: Gives Jasper medication daily or cleans the infected ear
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If treatment is needed, it means I did not discover the problem in time before, showing I am not careful enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Makes a care and medication schedule, follows it strictly, and continuously learns pet-care knowledge online
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I should have noticed this earlier

special_situations.event: At work, distracted attention and repetitive thinking due to worry about Jasper's condition
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: A qualified pet owner must always prevent problems before they happen, otherwise it is negligence
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: During work gaps, repeatedly searches information, blames themselves, and avoids sharing with colleagues to prevent being judged
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I made him suffer, showing I am incompetent

special_situations.event: Talking with other pet owners or searching online for ideal care standards
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only by obtaining others' recognition and the 'standard answer' do I count as a qualified owner
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Continuously seeks others' advice and online information to prove she is doing well enough
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not doing well enough; I need others to tell me what to do

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be a recognized, qualified caretaker, ensuring the important one (the pet) is safe and sound
core_conflict.fear: Fears harming a significant other through negligence and being seen as a failure, with ensuing guilt and self-deprecation
defense_goal: Through self-reproach and maintaining high standards, stays vigilant and in control, in order to avoid mistakes again

object_relations.object_representation: A vulnerable care-recipient needing my protection

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When self-blaming statements such as 'I should have noticed earlier' are mentioned, or when care details are attended to
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously interpreting uncontrollable factors as one's own dereliction, believing only harsher self-demands count as competent
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a gentle, Empathy tone, acknowledging their care and sense of responsibility; guiding to distinguish controllable from uncontrollable factors with open-ended Questioning, encouraging emotional naming and reality testing, reducing self-punishing language.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When facing uncertainty about causes and treatment while constantly searching for information, seeking 'perfect standards'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing finding the perfect answer can avoid mistakes, fighting Anxiety with rational analysis
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Lowering Interpretation intensity, inviting attention to present bodily and emotional experiences; replacing unlimited searching with concrete, limited fact-checking, reinforcing recognition of one's own effective behaviors.

manifestations: Living alone, depending on the cat Jasper; although colleagues are available to talk to, not yet sharing Guilt and self-blame feelings; the relationship with Jasper strained by guilt
outcomes: Decline in work concentration and Distraction

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Frequently using 'should' sentence patterns (such as 'I should have noticed earlier')
Judges his own caregiving behavior by high and rigid standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Excessive self-blame, attributing uncontrollable factors to oneself
Avoids expressing emotions to colleagues to avoid being judged

exception_events.target_problem: When pets develop health problems, the client usually sinks into Strong guilt and self-blame, ruminating repeatedly, leading to Sleep affected and Decline in work concentration.
exception_events.unique_outcome: After discovering Jasper's ear discomfort last week, the client did not delay but immediately took him to the vet and strictly followed the treatment plan, obtaining a clear diagnosis and care steps, showing responsible and effective coping.
exception_events.reason: Different approach: acting promptly and following professional advice; different support: receiving the Veterinarian's professional guidance and a clear care plan, enhancing the sense of control.

positive_force: Has strong love and a sense of responsibility toward pets
The drive to seek medical care promptly and strictly follow the treatment plan
Willing to learn (searches online, asks other pet owners)
Able to see their own positive behavior from others' perspective (can be reframed in session)
negative_force: Pattern of excessive self-blame and personalized attribution
Mental filtering tendency, focuses on the negative and ignores positive evidence
Insufficient sleep and persistent worry leading to Decreased attention

target_behavior.behavior: Persistent guilt and self-blame (emotional and cognitive reactions)
antecedent: Jasper showing discomfort or being reminded of continued treatment
The moment of daily medication or ear cleaning
Thinking 'I should have spotted the problem earlier'
target_behavior.core_reason: Personalizing uncontrollable causes as one's own fault, introjecting the outside world's 'perfect care' standard and demanding of oneself with 'should'.
target_behavior.function: Maintaining the moral sense and control of being a 'qualified owner' through self-punishment, trying to lower Anxiety about uncertainty.
target_behavior.consequence: Sleep disturbance, Decline in work concentration, tense interactions with the pet, overall well-being impaired.

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive online searching and seeking others' advice to repeatedly verify
antecedent: Facing situations where the cause is unclear or worrying about recurrence
Anxiety rising during Work breaks or when Being alone
target_behavior.core_reason: Relying on external validation to confirm whether one's care meets standards, trying to control uncertainty with information.
target_behavior.function: Gaining a brief sense of certainty and comfort, avoiding directly facing emotions of guilt and self-blame.
target_behavior.consequence: Worsening Distraction, Decline in work performance, the negative thought cycle reinforced.
